evals.prompt:
I'm a PM preparing for our 26-Q3 PI planning event which starts next week. Here are the themes we're considering:

1. 'Zero-Trust Network Access' - Status: Ready for Planning. Broken into 4 epics, dependencies with the infra team mapped.
2. 'Customer Self-Service Portal' - Status: HL Solution Design. Architecture still in progress, UX not finalized.
3. 'AI-Assisted Alert Triage' - Status: Ready for Planning. 3 epics defined, T-shirt sizes done.
4. 'Legacy API Deprecation' - Status: HL Product Design. PRD not mature, no R&D estimates yet.
5. 'SOC2 Type II Controls' - Status: Ready for Planning. 2 epics, security team owns it.

Which themes can we plan this PI, and what should we do about the ones that aren't ready?
evals.expected_output: Should identify themes 1, 3, and 5 as plannable. Theme 2 needs HL Solution Design completion before planning. Theme 4 has the most gaps and should not be planned. Should provide concrete next steps for each non-ready theme with owner recommendations.

assertions.name: correctly_identifies_ready_themes
assertions.description: Identifies themes 1, 3, and 5 as ready for planning and themes 2 and 4 as not ready

assertions.name: provides_gap_analysis
assertions.description: For each non-ready theme, explains what specific gaps prevent planning and who should address them

assertions.name: references_planned_equals_commit
assertions.description: Mentions the Planned = Commit principle in context of what it means for the themes being planned

assertions.name: actionable_output
assertions.description: Output includes concrete next steps with clear ownership (PM, PO, Architect) per theme

evals.prompt:
We're in the middle of 26-Q2 PI planning. I have 3 ready themes to plan across 6 sprints (S1-S6), each 2 weeks. The team has roughly 40 story points per sprint capacity.

Theme 1 (Priority 1): 'Kubernetes Migration' - 4 epics already defined:
  - Epic A: Containerize microservices (M, ~3 sprints)
  - Epic B: Set up K8s cluster (S, ~1 sprint)
  - Epic C: Migrate dev environment (M, ~2 sprints)
  - Epic D: Migrate prod environment (L, ~3 sprints)

Theme 2 (Priority 2): 'User Permissions Overhaul' - 3 epics:
  - Epic E: New roles data model (S, ~1 sprint)
  - Epic F: UI for role assignment (M, ~2 sprints)
  - Epic G: API enforcement layer (M, ~2 sprints)

Theme 3 (Priority 3): 'Reporting Dashboard v2' - 2 epics:
  - Epic H: New chart components (S, ~1 sprint)
  - Epic I: Data export feature (M, ~2 sprints)

Please generate a PI plan.
evals.expected_output: Should produce a sprint-by-sprint breakdown that respects dependencies (e.g., K8s cluster before migration, data model before UI/API). Should plan Theme 1 completely before moving to Theme 2. Should assign start and finish sprints to each epic. Should flag if anything can't fit and recommend stretch vs. commit status.

assertions.name: theme_priority_order
assertions.description: Plans Theme 1 fully before starting Theme 2, which is planned before Theme 3

assertions.name: start_finish_sprints_assigned
assertions.description: Every epic has an explicit start sprint and finish sprint assigned

assertions.name: logical_dependencies_respected
assertions.description: Epic B (K8s cluster setup) is planned before Epic D (prod migration); Epic E (data model) before Epic F and G

assertions.name: roadmap_table_format
assertions.description: Output includes a tabular roadmap showing Theme, Epic, Start Sprint, Finish Sprint, and Status

assertions.name: theme_finish_dates
assertions.description: Each Theme has an identified finish date based on its last epic's finish sprint

evals.prompt: I need to prepare for our bi-weekly grooming meeting for the 26-Q3 PI. We're 5 weeks out from PI start. Can you give me a meeting agenda and a checklist of what to validate for each theme in the backlog?
evals.expected_output: Should generate a practical bi-weekly grooming meeting agenda covering: priority review, readiness status per theme, scope changes (add/remove), open issues, and action items. Should include a per-theme readiness checklist aligned to the theme workflow phases (HL Product Design → HL Solution Design → Ready for Planning). Should mention the target of continuously moving themes to Ready for Implementation before PI planning.

assertions.name: meeting_agenda_structure
assertions.description: Provides a structured agenda with time boxes or sections for the grooming meeting

assertions.name: readiness_checklist
assertions.description: Includes a per-theme checklist that maps to the workflow phases (HL Product Design, HL Solution Design, Ready for Planning)

assertions.name: priority_vs_readiness_distinction
assertions.description: Clarifies that priority is set by business value, not readiness — critical items get higher priority regardless

assertions.name: scope_control_guidance
assertions.description: Mentions limiting theme count to team velocity and keeping only prioritized themes in the PI backlog
